items: Vertical 9:16 portrait format photograph. On a tidy white desk next to a bright window, two hands holding an open slim silver aluminium laptop with a plain lid and no logo tilted steeply, its screen switched off and plain black, the black keyboard facing the camera with a few crumbs between the keys, a plain white aerosol can with a thin red straw standing upright beside it, close-up. Photorealistic, soft daylight, rolled-up sleeves of a charcoal-grey cotton shirt, no face visible. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
